title: TUI spec-check screen: overflow marker for a tall permission detail
lead: *Proposed.* The spec-check screen uses S373's overflow marker when a permission detail does not fit.
findings_note: S375 (2026-11-16): the spec-check screen shows a permission question's whole detail (S375); a detail taller than the screen pushes other rows off it. S373's run pane drops a tall detail whole behind an overflow marker. Owner decision adj 383 (`ui.permission-detail-speccheck-overflow`, later).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: *Proposed.* A tall detail can hide the rest of the spec-check screen at 80x24.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - `TestSpecCheckTallPermissionDetailOverflows`: at 80x24, a 2,000-character detail renders S373's overflow marker instead of the detail, and the rest of the screen keeps its rows (golden).

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Red test, then the view, reusing S373's marker.
2. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md`. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet under `## Unreleased`.
